_doc: PRIOR ART: scripts/lib/ocr-routing-table.json (the OCR side, by page kind, #6688; its `route` fields are read by ocr-routing.mjs since #7170). Before #7170 the translation policy lived only as two regexes in scripts/lib/translate-core.mjs and their TS twin in src/lib/types/ai-models.ts. This file is that policy, READ by both routers (getTranslateModelForBook): the first row whose `match` fits the book gives the engine, else `default`. A `language_prefix` matches the FIRST language label, case-insensitively, as a whole word, with any run of spaces for a space ("greek" matches "Greek, Latin" and not "Latin; Greek"); `optional_lead` words may stand before any prefix ("Ancient Hebrew"). A row is `channel: "batch"` (the default) or `channel: "cli"` (#7075). A batch row names one of the two Batch models (gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash-preview). A cli row names a subscription reader (CLI_TRANSLATE_LANES in translation-routing.mjs: claude-opus-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash+agy-cli), carries `adoption` (the blind sample against the reader it replaces), may carry `per_call` (agy block reader, 1-4 pages a call, #7263) and OVERLAYS the batch rows (so a cli row that must not take BPH books says `unless: { providers: ["bph"] }`): the Batch routers never see it, and the pipeline orchestrator holds its books (CLI_TRANSLATE_HOLD) for scripts/batch/cli-translate-lane.mjs. Any other engine or channel fails the test. Changes are proposed by scripts/eval/estimator/routing/derive_routes.py and land as a reviewed edit of this file with the evidence that justifies them. tests/unit/translate-core-parity.test.ts pins the two routers to each other and to this file.

rows.why: Derek, 2026-11-06: "no one should use lite", "everything on agy", "its just better and cheaper". Every book no earlier cli row takes (Spanish, Dutch, Portuguese, the non-Latin scripts once on Batch Flash, BPH) translates on agy 3.8 Flash-low, 4 pages a call. Measured as a cell for Latin, German, Italian and French (rows above); for the rest the adoption sample is the nearest measured cell, and the nightly lane judge is the check.

Do not edit: move the pointer in current.json and run the script with --write; tests/unit/router-routing-rows-7913.test.ts fails while this block and current.json disagree. getOcrModelForBook routes from this block in the OCR table (`reads`, #8283); lanes bind through routeCheck (scripts/lib/router-binding.mjs); translation's routers read `rows`, and tests/unit/router-bound-table.test.ts fails when they disagree with it.
